message: Co-sign. I’m not anti-safety, I’m anti “compliance maze.” Focus regs on high-stakes deployments + truly frontier systems (evals, incident reporting, security, clear liability). Give low-risk/internal tools a safe harbor + standard templates so it doesn’t turn into a BigCo moat.
reason: Matches my view: targeted guardrails over broad regulation, with safe harbors to avoid entrenching incumbents.

message: Yeah this is my worry too: protect people in high-stakes uses (hiring/pay/credit/health) w/ notice, logs, audits + clear liability. But if “stronger regs” = huge paperwork for every small tool, it just hands the market to Big Tech. Risk-tiered + simple standards > blanket rules.
reason: I somewhat oppose stronger regulation in general, but agree targeted, risk-based rules and liability for high-stakes deployments make sense without creating a compliance moat.
